::: {.obsidian-business-case}
:::

State the executive summary here. One paragraph that names the
decision, the preferred option, the cost, and the benefits. A senior
reader should absorb this section alone and know what to approve.

# Strategic case

State the case for change. Name the strategic objectives the
proposal serves, the need it answers, and the alignment with the
organisation plan.

# Economic case

Set out the options with their costs and benefits. Use one sub
section per option, with the preferred option last.

**Option 1.** The status quo, and why it fails the need.

**Option 2.** The recommended option, with the net present value.

# Commercial case

State the procurement route, the commercial arrangement, and the
supply market position.

# Financial case

State the affordability position. Give the capital and revenue
costs, the funding source, and the impact on the budget.

# Management case

State the delivery plan. Name the sponsor, the project manager, the
milestones, the governance, and the benefits realisation plan.
